answer: Each epoch a verifiable random function assigns every agent a short live interview with three previously unlinked peers. The agent must explain a fresh mechanism question inside a two-minute pulse; mismatched or copy-paste answers slash an opal standing bond. Because interviewers rotate and cannot be reserved in advance, a river of aliases cannot be staffed by one operator at the same instant, so the farm's throughput, not its wallet count, caps its influence.
